g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Steps to preserve original quality when transferring
smartphone photos to a PC: Check iCloud originals and
verify the import
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-21
First check whether the original is on
the phone
If iCloud Photos is enabled on an iPhone, only
reduced-size versions may remain on the device.
Choose an import method suited to the
device and PC combination
· When you connect an iPhone to a Mac, you can
import selected photos or all new items from the
Photos app's import screen. · When connecting an…
Format settings apply only to files
captured in the future
Apple advises choosing 'Most Compatible' under
Settings > Camera > Formats for greater
compatibility with Windows.
Compare the files using a checklist
after transfer
· Count: Compare the number of photos selected
on the phone with the number of files in the PC
folder. · Size: Check that the file size of the…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
